name: browser-use
headline: Prism - Custom Status Line for Claude Code
short_description: Prism is a fast, customizable status line for Claude Code. It provides real-time updates and visual feedback for operations teams. Integrates with Claude Code plugins to enhance workflow visibility.
author: himattm

sections.overview:
Prism is a native Go status line for Claude Code that displays actionable real-time context usage, git branch information, model details, and device status. It executes plugins in parallel for performance and supports a three-tier configuration system for personal, team, and global settings. Prism automatically detects your billing type to show either API costs with cache efficiency and burn rate, or Max/Pro plan usage limits with countdown timers. The tool includes built-in plugins for Android devices, Spotify, agent task queues, and automatic updates, while also supporting custom plugins written in any language. Operations teams and developers benefit from enhanced workflow visibility and context awareness directly in their Claude Code interface.
Monitor API billing costs, cache efficiency, and burn rate in real-time while working in Claude Code
Track Max/Pro plan usage limits with countdown timers for session, weekly, and Opus-specific constraints
Display git branch status, uncommitted changes, and Android device information in the status line
Configure team-wide status line settings via committed repo config while allowing personal overrides
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/himattm/prism`
sections.usage:
```
Use Prism to monitor and display real-time status for [OPERATION]. Configure the status line to show [METRICS] such as [EXAMPLE_METRIC_1], [EXAMPLE_METRIC_2], and [EXAMPLE_METRIC_3]. Highlight any anomalies or thresholds breached in [COLOR]. Provide a summary of the current state and suggest corrective actions if needed.
```
Copy

```
```
🔄 [OPERATION: Data Pipeline Sync] | Status: RUNNING | Duration: 42m 15s
📊 Metrics:
  • Input Records: 12,487/15,000 (83%) [⚠️ WARNING: 90% threshold]
  • Output Records: 11,234/15,000 (75%) [❌ CRITICAL: Lag detected]
  • Errors: 42 (0.34%) [✅ OK: Below 1% threshold]
  • Processing Speed: 342 records/min [⚡ ACCELERATING]
🚨 Alerts:
  - Output lag detected (12m behind schedule)
  - Input records nearing capacity (1,513 remaining)
💡 Suggested Actions:
  1. Pause non-critical jobs to free resources
  2. Investigate output bottleneck in 'transform' stage
  3. Prepare scale-up for input buffer (current: 80%)
```

Current Status: The data pipeline sync is actively running but showing critical output lag. The system has processed 83% of input records but only 75% of output records, indicating a potential bottleneck in the transformation phase. The error rate remains acceptable, but the lag suggests resource contention. The processing speed is improving, which may help close the gap. Immediate intervention is needed to prevent data loss or downstream failures.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
